evidence.excerpt: Dragan Hadžić received his Dipl.Ing. in Industrial Engineering from the Faculty of Technical Sciences, University of Novi Sad, in 2003, and his PhD from the same institution in 2010, with a dissertation on workload-dependent pricing in make-to-order manufacturing systems. He joined the Department of Industrial Engineering and Management as a teaching assistant in 2004 and was promoted to Associate Professor in 2018. His research group focuses on dynamic pricing mechanisms, revenue management, and queueing-theoretic capacity models for job-shop and custom-manufacturing environments. He teaches courses in production planning, operations research, and pricing strategy at both undergraduate and graduate levels. The group uses simulation software (Arena, AnyLogic) and statistical computing environments (R, Python) for model estimation and validation, and has access to the Faculty's industrial simulation laboratory.
